title: Oracle ready configuration
statement: Given a Boolean input list $x$, a tape-content function $f:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, an integer $p$, a Boolean side, an argument list, a dispatch state $q$, an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions, and an output list, define a four-work-tape configuration in state $q$ with that input-head position and output. The first tape is $f$ with its value at $-1$ erased; the second is the fixed origin contents with its value at $p$ set to false; the third is blank except that cells $0$ and $1$ are assigned values determined by $p$, the side, and $f(-1)$; and the fourth contains the argument in buffer form. All four heads are at $0$.
caveat: The fixed origin contents and the buffer-tape construction are referenced but not defined in the supplied payload.
